description:
Check the payment status of a Lightning invoice.

Call after paying the invoice from purchase_credits.
Free — no credits required. Proof of npub ownership is required
to prevent credit-grant front-running by an observer of the
invoice ID.

dpop_token.description:
Proof that the caller holds npub: the grant envelope from
receive_npub_proof, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed
by npub whose `u` tag is this tool's name.

invoice_id.description: The invoice ID returned by purchase_credits.

npub.description: The Nostr public key (npub1...) that purchased the invoice.

name: authority_check_payment
title: Check payment
